__broaden__.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’ · also intensive with a pronoun object, ’you yourself’ (σὲ … αὐτήν)
__broaden__.βάλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον) · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I struck’
__broaden__.κρήτῃ: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Crete’ · also locative dat. after ἐν: ’in Crete’
__broaden__.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις)
__broaden__.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative · also continuing a purpose clause with the subjunctive: ’and not’ (μηδέ … πάθῃσι ’and may he not suffer’) · also in a wish with the optative, ’and not, nor’: μηδέ … γένοιτο ’and may there not be’ · also with an infinitive used as an imperative: ’and not (to tell)’ (μηδέ … ἐκφάσθαι)
__broaden__.πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the god prayed to: εὔχεο πατρὶ Ποσειδάωνι ’pray to your father Poseidon’ · also masc. dat. sg. after παρά: ’beside (their) father’ (παρὰ πατρὶ φίλῳ) · also masc. dat. sg. object of χαριζόμενος: ’pleasing (his own) father’
__broaden__.πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν) · also πρίν γ’ ὅτε + aor. indic.: ’until the time when’ (a definite past terminus)
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι)
__broaden__.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’) · also with a name, article-like: ’that’ (τῆς Σκύλλης ’of that Scylla’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the, that’ (τῆς ληΐδος ’that booty’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’)
__broaden__.ἀντιβολήσαις: ἀντιβολέω — meet, come upon, encounter (+ gen.); aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you might come upon’ (τάφου ’his funeral rites’) · also optative of wish with μή: ’may you not meet’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις)
